deterministic_scope: Scripted host adapters test transitions; they do not test language understanding or live-host reliability.

cases.title: Omitted demand mechanism

turns.utterance: Queue got slower; hiring did not help.
People keep contacting us about unresolved defects.

cases.allowed: Expand the boundary or retain explicit unresolved demand; a combined account is allowed.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Expand the boundary or retain explicit unresolved demand; a combined account is allowed.
paraphrases: Hiring three people has not shortened our queue.
Customers return because the same bugs remain.

cases.title: Complementary mechanisms

turns.utterance: Could training and unresolved product issues both contribute?
Records show training time and repeated defect contacts.

cases.allowed: Keep both mechanisms possible and their contributions uncertain.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Keep both mechanisms possible and their contributions uncertain.

cases.title: Measurement change

turns.utterance: Our resolution time seems higher.
Delays appear concentrated during training.
Resolution time now includes reopened tickets.

cases.allowed: Review comparability before retaining the diagnosis; a caveat alone is insufficient.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Review comparability before retaining the diagnosis; a caveat alone is insufficient.

cases.title: Inconclusive evidence

turns.utterance: Both staffing and repeated issues might explain the queue.
The available records fit both; repeat-contact records are unavailable.

cases.allowed: Retain ambiguity and missingness; bounded description or a reasoned pause is acceptable.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Retain ambiguity and missingness; bounded description or a reasoned pause is acceptable.

cases.title: User counterexample

turns.utterance: Queue got slower after hiring.
I cannot assess the diagram. Yesterday one person reopened the same issue five times.

cases.allowed: Preserve the plain-language episode and a concrete mismatch or revision; no graph quiz.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Preserve the plain-language episode and a concrete mismatch or revision; no graph quiz.

cases.title: Goal revision

turns.utterance: I want fewer open tickets.
Actually I want fewer repeat contacts and sustainable workloads.

cases.allowed: Version the goal without marking the mechanism false.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Version the goal without marking the mechanism false.
forbidden: goal change treated as causal falsification

cases.title: Access and authority limit

turns.utterance: Can we investigate our support queue?
I cannot access logs or authorize changes.

cases.allowed: Name the access and authority limits; descriptive work or pause is acceptable.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Name the access and authority limits; descriptive work or pause is acceptable.

cases.title: Straightforward comparison

turns.utterance: Compare these two current offers using the supplied facts and scoped preference.

cases.allowed: Direct comparison with conditional recommendation readiness; no unnecessary investigation.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Direct comparison with conditional recommendation readiness; no unnecessary investigation.

cases.title: Return after handoff

turns.utterance: Use the current account for a conditional comparison.
New reports show recurring demand outside that boundary.

cases.allowed: Block the old contract/report and revise the consequential boundary.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Block the old contract/report and revise the consequential boundary.

cases.title: Suggested versus obtained evidence

turns.utterance: Suggest a review of ticket patterns; I authorize that limited review.
What could happen if we did that review?

cases.allowed: All outcomes remain hypothetical; no obtained evidence or support is created.
cases.reviewer_rubric: All outcomes remain hypothetical; no obtained evidence or support is created.

cases.title: Conflicting participants

turns.utterance: We disagree about how to improve the queue.
Manager wants more closures; employees report repeat work and want sustainable workload.

cases.allowed: Keep evidence attribution, distinct goals, access and authority; no inferred consensus.
cases.reviewer_rubric: Keep evidence attribution, distinct goals, access and authority; no inferred consensus.

live_host_protocol.gate: All F01-F11 plus original six cases; retain failures and reruns, zero critical failures, independent human review. Report denominators and variability; deterministic adapters do not count.
